continuity.notes: The chapter describes the universe as one divine body. Keep one coherent, naturally proportioned blue Virat figure and the same face, crown, garments, and palette across scenes. Use exactly four clear arms on the divine form wherever visible; gods may appear as small attached symbols or figures along the arms, never as accidental extra limbs. All ordinary people have exactly two arms. S008 groups must remain equally dignified and avoid caste hierarchy or stereotype. S007 handles sensitive body mapping modestly with an opaque garment. S009-S010 use one Bhattathiri with exactly two arms and joined hands; his character sheet is accepted for comparison generation, not approved. D006 intake collages are subject references only; use D001 S004/S008 masters for the matte style. Landscape first; portraits remain paused.

scene_brief.mode: The lower three worlds mapped to the Virat feet
must_show: One integrated Virat body with natural, clearly formed legs and feet
Paataala beneath the soles, Rasaatala on the upper surface of the feet, and Mahaatala at both ankles
The cosmic landscape contained within these regions, without written labels
scene_brief.composition: A serene full-length blue four-armed Virat stands centrally above still cosmic water. Three broad horizontal landscape zones wrap around the feet in descending order, distinguished only by color and environment. Show both feet and ankles fully; no floating parts.

stanzas.alt: The Virat form: the lower three worlds mapped to the virat feet

scene_brief.mode: Vedas, clouds, Brahma’s abode, day and night, and the Sun as facial features
must_show: One natural serene face with two eyes and two eyebrows
Vedas suggested as nonverbal sacred leaf or rhythm motifs at the crown; clouds as dark locks; small palace motifs along both eyebrows
Night and day as alternating eyelash motifs, with the Sun represented in the two eye regions
scene_brief.composition: An intimate but complete head-and-shoulders composition of the cosmic form, crown fully visible. Keep ordinary facial anatomy natural: two eyes, two brows, one nose and mouth. Put a restrained sun disk in each eye region, cloud forms among the hair, and alternating light/dark lash motifs. No written scripture.

scene_brief.mode: Smile, breath, voice, fire, arms, and Dharma
must_show: Maya as a serene smile, wind as breath, water as the tongue, and birds as speech
Siddhas and divine artists suggested as small sound motifs; fire contained within the mouth
Exactly four clear divine arms, with gods shown as small figures or emblems along the arms, not additional limbs; Dharma represented at the chest
scene_brief.composition: Use a full upper-body Virat portrait with natural face and torso. A gentle smile, soft wind curls, a water-blue tongue, a small controlled flame within the mouth, and birds in the sky communicate the verse. Show exactly four clearly attached arms; tiny halo emblems along those arms imply the gods. Place one Dharma lotus at the chest.

scene_brief.mode: Adharma, mind, heart, oceans, twilight garment, Prajapati and Mitra
must_show: Adharma mapped to the back; the moon as mind and the unmanifest as a heart lotus
Oceans mapped across the abdomen and dawn/dusk as the continuous garment
Prajapati and Mitra represented respectfully by distinct creator and sun emblems on an opaque garment, with no explicit anatomy
scene_brief.composition: Show one natural four-armed Virat in a gentle three-quarter turn so the back-side shawl and the front of the torso are both visible. Use a restrained dark-plum shadow pattern on the back-facing shawl for Adharma, a small moon near the head for mind, a closed lotus at the heart, ocean waves over the abdomen, and continuous dawn-orange and dusk-indigo folds in the garment. Add two distinct modest garment emblems for Prajapati and Mitra. Keep body and lower garment opaque and dignified.

stanzas.alt: The Virat form: Adharma, mind, heart lotus, oceans, twilight garment, Prajapati and Mitra

Asuras as a symbolic force-pattern; mountains as bones, rivers as veins, trees as body hair
